\section[(dialogue)]{Nature, animals and describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R81-first-pass-nature-animals-and-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to lose and to arrive.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a tree, a flower, a leaf; a sheet of paper, a mountain, a forest
  \item a river, a lake, a stone, sand, an island
  \item a field; the countryside, the sky, the sun, a star, a cloud
  \item rain, the wind, a hill, a desert, fire
  \item a dog, a cat, a horse, a cow, a pig
  \item a bird, a mouse, a wolf, a bear, a fox
  \item a snake, a hen, a duck, a sheep, a goat
  \item a lion, a monkey, a bee, an ant, an elephant
  \item big, small, new; young, old, bad
  \item pretty, ugly, long, short, hot
  \item fast, slow, easy, difficult, expensive; dear
  \item cheap, tall, short, full, empty
  \item strong, weak, rich, poor, yellow
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A tree? (\textbf{a árvore}.) A flower? (\textbf{a flor}.) A leaf; a sheet of paper? (\textbf{a folha}.) A mountain? (\textbf{a montanha}.) A forest? (\textbf{a floresta}.) A river? (\textbf{o rio}.) A lake? (\textbf{o lago}.) A stone? (\textbf{a pedra}.) Sand? (\textbf{a areia}.) An island? (\textbf{a ilha}.) A field; the countryside? (\textbf{o campo}.) The sky? (\textbf{o céu}.) The sun? (\textbf{o fogo}.) A dog? (\textbf{o cão}.) A cat? (\textbf{o gato}.) A horse? (\textbf{o cavalo}.) A cow? (\textbf{a vaca}.) A pig? (\textbf{o porco}.) A bird? (\textbf{o pássaro}.) A mouse? (\textbf{o rato}.) A wolf? (\textbf{o lobo}.) A bear? (\textbf{o urso}.) A fox? (\textbf{a raposa}.) A snake? (\textbf{a cobra}.) A hen? (\textbf{a galinha}.) A duck? (\textbf{o pato}.) A sheep? (\textbf{a ovelha}.) A goat? (\textbf{a cabra}.) A lion? (\textbf{o leão}.) A monkey? (\textbf{o macaco}.) A bee? (\textbf{a abelha}.) An ant? (\textbf{a formiga}.) An elephant? (\textbf{o elefante}.) Big? (\textbf{grande}.) Small? (\textbf{pequeno}.) New; young? (\textbf{novo}.) Old? (\textbf{velho}.) Bad? (\textbf{mau}.) Pretty? (\textbf{bonito}.) Ugly? (\textbf{feio}.) Long? (\textbf{longo}.) Short? (\textbf{curto}.) Hot? (\textbf{quente}.) Fast? (\textbf{rápido}.) Slow? (\textbf{lento}.) Easy? (\textbf{fácil}.) Difficult? (\textbf{difícil}.) Expensive; dear? \section[(dialogue)]{Time, the town, clothes and more verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R81-second-pass-time-the-town-clothes-and-more-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for green and grey.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item green, grey, sweet, clean, dirty
  \item a week, a month, the morning, a minute, always
  \item never, now, afterwards, early, slowly
  \item here, there, far, near, quickly
  \item a city, a street, a shop, a market, a bank; a bench
  \item a station, an aeroplane, a car, a bridge, a park
  \item a church, a museum, a restaurant, a hotel, a pharmacy
  \item a village, the post; the post office, the police, a theatre, a library
  \item clothes, a shirt, a dress, trousers, shoes
  \item a hat, a coat, a skirt, socks, a belt
  \item forty, fifty, a hundred, a thousand, zero
  \item to pay, to use; to wear, to show, to clean, to cut
  \item to remember, to forget, to look for, to lose, to arrive
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Green? (\textbf{verde}.) Grey? (\textbf{cinzento}.) Sweet? (\textbf{doce}.) Clean? (\textbf{limpo}.) Dirty? (\textbf{sujo}.) A week? (\textbf{a semana}.) A month? (\textbf{o mês}.) The morning? (\textbf{a manhã}.) A minute? (\textbf{o minuto}.) Always? (\textbf{sempre}.) Never? (\textbf{nunca}.) Now? (\textbf{agora}.) Afterwards? (\textbf{depois}.) Early? (\textbf{cedo}.) Slowly? (\textbf{a ponte}.) A park? (\textbf{o parque}.) A church? (\textbf{a igreja}.) A museum? (\textbf{o museu}.) A restaurant? (\textbf{o restaurante}.) A hotel? (\textbf{o hotel}.) A pharmacy? (\textbf{a farmácia}.) A village? (\textbf{a aldeia}.) The post; the post office? (\textbf{o correio}.) The police? (\textbf{a polícia}.) A theatre? (\textbf{o teatro}.) A library? (\textbf{a biblioteca}.) Clothes? (\textbf{a roupa}.) A shirt? (\textbf{a camisa}.) A dress? (\textbf{o vestido}.) Trousers? (\textbf{as calças}.) Shoes? (\textbf{os sapatos}.) A hat? (\textbf{o chapéu}.) A coat? (\textbf{o casaco}.) A skirt? (\textbf{a saia}.) Socks? (\textbf{as meias}.) A belt? (\textbf{o cinto}.) Forty? (\textbf{quarenta}.) Fifty? (\textbf{cinquenta}.) A hundred? (\textbf{cem}.) A thousand? (\textbf{mil}.) Zero? (\textbf{zero}.) To pay? (\textbf{pagar}.) To use; to wear? (\textbf{usar}.) To show? (\textbf{mostrar}.) To clean? (\textbf{limpar}.) To cut? (\textbf{cortar}.) To remember? (\textbf{lembrar}.) To forget? (\textbf{esquecer}.) To look for? (\textbf{procurar}.) To lose? (\textbf{perder}.) To arrive? (\textbf{chegar}.)
